words.gloss: things that are unproductive or useless

literal: Pleasing things speaking, useless things at all times, even if asked, not speaking, refrain.
translation: Speak only of things that are pleasing to the ruler; even if asked, always refrain from speaking about things that are unproductive or harmful.
modern: அரசருக்குப் பிடிக்கும் காரியங்களை மட்டும் பேசி, அவரே கேட்டாலும் பயனில்லாத காரியங்களை எக்காலத்திலும் சொல்லாமல் தவிர்த்துவிட வேண்டும்.
explanation: This couplet guides those who serve or advise rulers on the art of safe and effective communication. A courtier should proactively speak of matters that are agreeable and beneficial (வேட்பன சொல்லி). Conversely, matters that are useless, harmful, or lack constructive action (வினையில) must never be spoken of, even if the ruler specifically inquires about them (கேட்பினும் சொல்லா விடல்). This selective silence protects the advisor and maintains the harmony of the court.
